opening: I run a small bakery with eight staff and I keep losing hours to scheduling. I built a spreadsheet that handles our early shifts, and I think other bakeries would pay for an app that does the same. Where should I start?
founder: Fair. Last Tuesday I spent about three hours on the schedule. Two of my bakers can only work before 6am, and my counter people change their hours by text all week. The worst one was a Saturday in March: nobody covered the 4am shift and I lost the wholesale order for the cafe down the street.

Two owners at the farmers market. The one with the bread stall said she lost a restaurant account last winter after two missed early deliveries, and she asked if she could use my spreadsheet. The other one said scheduling is annoying but her group chat works fine.
Around fifteen bakeries near me sell wholesale, and I know six of the owners. The stall owner has used my sheet for three weeks and hasn't missed an early shift. I haven't asked her to pay anything.
